title: In an all-hands, Jensen Huang apologized for violating Nvidia's code of conduct, saying he is in therapy after making "very serious personal mistakes" (Paresh Dave/Wired)
summary: Paresh Dave / Wired: In an all-hands, Jensen Huang apologized for violating Nvidia's code of conduct, saying he is in therapy after making “very serious personal mistakes” — The reinstated Nvidia CEO acknowledged violating the company's code of conduct and said he had made some “very serious personal mistakes.”
contentText:
Paresh Dave / Wired :

In an all-hands, Jensen Huang apologized for violating Nvidia's code of conduct, saying he is in therapy after making “very serious personal mistakes”   —  The reinstated Nvidia CEO acknowledged violating the company's code of conduct and said he had made some “very serious personal mistakes.”
